mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.2 percentage points over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions and impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous expansion in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust economic growth and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of joint expansion periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is expected to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of high inflation periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong housing market (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of periods when HOUST > 12mo avg, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.0% over the past month signals a manufacturing slowdown and impending economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month), consumer spending and corporate earnings are supported, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of tight labor market periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals a strong labor market without monetary tightening, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%
regime_hint: expansionary labor market with accommodative policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of joint signal periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
